title: Lovable confirms new $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M
summary: Europe’s favorite vibe-coding startup Lovable has confirmed previously reported whispers that it was raising another mega round at a $13.3 billion valuation. Note: one of Lovable’s new Series C investors is Regent, the investment firm that also owns TechCrunch.
